La inflación anual estimada del IPC en septiembre de 2026 es del 4,9%, de acuerdo con el indicador adelantado elaborado por el INE. En este comportamiento influyen los precios de los combustibles y lubricantes para vehículos personales, que suben mientras que en septiembre de 2025 bajaron; y también los paquetes turísticos, cuyos precios descienden menos que en el mismo mes del año pasado. La tasa de variación anual estimada de la inflación subyacente (índice general sin alimentos no elaborados ni productos energéticos) aumenta dos décimas, hasta el 3,1%.

China just announced some fiscal + monetary easing measures. No indications of a broad-based stimulus, still "targeted/measured" easing via fiscal + credit Some highlights: - 25bp cut in the PSL rate + an expansion of PSL support to the "Six Networks" projects. 1-year rate down to 1.5% (from 1.75%, ~1.4% for 1-year policy bank bond yields) - Raised quota for technology innovation & equipment upgrade relending program by RMB 200bn (with the funding ratio increased to 100% from 60% previously) - Higher quotas for various relending programs - First-ever mortgage interest subsidy for eligible first-home purchases (but relatively tight eligibility requirements such as home price cap of RMB 1.5mm & no larger than 120 square meters or ~1300 sq. ft.) - In 2025, Homes <120sqm were ~54% of new transactions across 30 major cities - Mortgage interest subsidy is roughly 1/3 of the current borrowing rate Initial market response is little impact beyond property, but from my exp. it usually takes a bit FYI in Aug fiscal policy remained a growth drag, but things started to pick up in Sep with govt bond issuance accelerating, & there's been media reports that implementation of a RMB 800B (~$120B USD) policy-based financial instrument is beginning $FXI $KWEB $CNXT $KSTR $ASHR $BABA
